about: Boundary joins shared by tools/voices/test_boundary.py and BoundaryPolicyTest (QC 2026-10-30 V2). A fixture policy, so tuning the shipped values never breaks the table. Clips are [leading silence ms, voiced ms, trailing silence ms] at 1000 Hz; voiced samples are 1000. 'heard_gaps_ms' are the silent runs between voiced spans; 'total_ms' proves nothing is added after the last clip.

joins.name: edges longer than the target are kept, never trimmed
speaker turn with no edge silence
mixed boundaries and no final pad
